intro: Bahraini culture is shaped by the sea, pearling, and a long history of trade.

chapters.title: The pearling trail
text: Muharraq's pearling path, with merchants' houses and oyster beds, is on the World Heritage list.

chapters.title: Food
text: Machboos, halwa and fresh fish like hamour are local favourites.

keyTerms.meaning: Diving for oysters to find pearls.

items.title: Fijiri
items.subtitle: Traditional
items.text: Work songs once sung by pearl divers.
